reviewer: AI assistant; original-document verification, not independent human validation
scope: Resolve the two exact original-document locators left unresolved by the base record. Do not replace its historical observations or broaden its bibliography coverage.

checks.reference: Markowitz (1952), Portfolio Selection, The Journal of Finance 7(1), 77–91
checks.claim: Portfolio variance has the covariance quadratic form w^T Sigma w.

locator.download_variant: Berkeley-hosted JSTOR scan; 16 physical PDF pages including cover
locator.visible_evidence: The page displays the double covariance sum and applies it to portfolio weights; it also specifies weights summing to one and no short selling.

checks.interpretation: The double covariance sum is the matrix expression w^T Sigma w. This supports the risk-formula ancestry, not a claim that this project implements a Markowitz optimum.
limits: The download is a scan mirror, not certification that its bytes match the current publisher PDF.
The 60-observation window, sample-covariance convention, annualization factor 252 and finite-sample reliability are not established by this original formula locator.
checks.proposed_correction: No formula correction required. Preserve the distinction between descriptive covariance-based risk and optimization/performance validation.

checks.reference: Hornuf et al. (2025), Making GenAI Smarter: Evidence from a Portfolio Allocation Experiment, CESifo Working Paper 11862
checks.claim: A twelve-month horizon occurs among the original experiment’s investor-profile conditions.

locator.download_variant: EconStor copy with repository wrapper, 96 physical pages; paper dated April 30, 2025
locator.visible_evidence: The table crosses 1-, 6- and 12-month horizons with high/low risk preferences and yes/no ESG; profiles 3, 6, 9 and 12 use twelve months.

checks.interpretation: Twelve months is one experimental level. It provides a precedent for an explicit horizon, not an empirical proof that twelve months is optimal or an actual institution mandate.
limits: The additional repository wrapper shifts this locator by one physical page relative to the earlier 95-page official-PDF observation.
The official PDF later returned an HTML challenge/timeout; no byte identity between official and repository variants is claimed.
checks.proposed_correction: Retain the limited precedent claim; cite Table A1 (printed A-1), with the PDF-variant-aware locator.

errors.reason: Both previously unresolved narrow claims now have inspected original-document page evidence; no contradiction found for these claims.

consistency.reason: The historical base review remains unchanged; page variants and failed access are distinguished; no manuscript or protocol edits were made.

paper_topic.reason: The checks support explicitly declared task horizon and descriptive allocation-risk foundations. They do not broaden the paper into investment-performance, institutional-mandate or optimizer validation.

method.intermediate_render: paper_citation_addendum_hornuf_p53_intermediate.png was an initially off-by-one physical-page selection, correctly renamed; it is not the evidence for Table A1.
method.visual_verification: Relevant page PNGs were inspected with the image viewer. Remote screenshot outputs were text-only, so they were not treated as viewed images.
